info.title: Bankstatemently API
info.description:
[Bankstatemently - PDF to CSV Bank Statement Converter](https://bankstatemently.com)

Convert bank statement PDFs into structured data. Upload a PDF, poll for completion, then export as JSON, CSV, XLSX, QBO, or Xero-compatible formats.

Full docs: [bankstatemently.com/developers/api](https://bankstatemently.com/developers/api)

post.description: Upload a PDF bank statement for conversion. The file is processed asynchronously. Poll the returned `id` via GET /v1/documents/{id} to check progress. Rate limit: 10 requests per minute.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key to ensure the request is processed at most once. Must be unique per request — use a UUID. Keys expire after 24 hours. If a duplicate key is detected, the original response is replayed with `X-Idempotency-Replayed: true`.

parameters.name: X-Filename
parameters.description: Original filename for the uploaded PDF. Used for display purposes only. Defaults to 'document.pdf' if not provided.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-URL
parameters.description: Webhook URL for processing completion notifications. Overrides the default webhook URL configured on the API key.

parameters.name: X-Password
parameters.description: Decryption password for encrypted PDFs. When provided, the PDF is decrypted and processed in a single request — no need for the two-step unlock flow. The password is used in memory only and never stored or logged.

parameters.name: retry
parameters.description: Set to 'true' to reprocess a previously failed upload of the same file. Without this, re-uploading a failed file returns an already_processing error.

schema.description: The raw PDF bank statement bytes. Set Content-Type to application/pdf.

202.description: Upload accepted. Processing has started, or the PDF requires a password.

400.description: Invalid request (e.g., missing file, wrong content type, invalid file).

error.message: No file provided. Send a PDF as multipart/form-data with field name "file".
Invalid file type. Only PDF files are supported.
This file could not be read as a valid PDF. It may be corrupted.
Invalid webhook_url: Webhook URL must use HTTPS.

403.description: Quota exceeded (insufficient credits, page limit, or file size).

insufficient_credits.summary: Not enough credits to process file

error.message: Insufficient credits. This file requires 3 credit(s) but you have 1 remaining. Purchase more at https://bankstatemently.com/pricing.
Page limit exceeded. This file has 25 pages but your plan allows 10. Upgrade at https://bankstatemently.com/pricing.
File too large. Your plan allows files up to 10 MB. Upgrade at https://bankstatemently.com/pricing.

409.description: Document already exists or is being processed.

error.message: This document is already being processed. Poll GET /v1/documents/{id} for status updates.

422.description: Wrong password. Only returned when X-Password header is provided for an encrypted PDF.

error.message: The password provided is incorrect. Please try again.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of your uploaded documents, ordered by creation date descending. Rate limit: 120 requests per minute.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of documents to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of documents to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter documents by processing status.

get.description: Poll the status of an uploaded document. When status is `completed`, the response includes statement metadata and export URLs. Rate limit: 120 requests per minute.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document UUID returned from the upload endpoint.

value.error: Unable to extract data from PDF. The file may be scanned or password-protected.

404.description: Document not found or does not belong to the authenticated user.

error.message: Document not found.

get.description: Retrieve structured document data including accounts and transactions. Only available when document status is `completed`. Transactions are paginated. Rate limit: 60 requests per minute.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document UUID.

parameters.name: raw
parameters.description: Set to `true` to include `originalData` (raw pre-normalization cell values) on each transaction. When enabled, max limit is reduced to 500.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of transactions per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of transactions to skip for pagination.

200.description: Structured document data. Primary shape: document.statements[].products[].accounts[].transactions[]. Legacy flat accounts[] and transactions[] retained for backward compatibility.

error.message: Document not found.
Document is not ready (status: processing). Poll GET /v1/documents/{id} until status is "completed".

get.description: Download the processed document in the specified format. The document must have status `completed`. Rate limit: 30 requests per minute.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document UUID.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The export format.

parameters.name: dataMode
parameters.description: The data mode to export. `original` returns raw extracted data; `enhanced` (default) includes AI-enriched fields; `normalized` applies standardized formatting.

parameters.name: dateFormat
parameters.description: Date format string for Xero CSV exports (e.g., `DD/MM/YYYY`). Only applicable when format is `xero`.

200.description: The exported file. Content-Type varies by format.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename for the exported file.

schema.description: Structured JSON export of the document.

error.message: Invalid dataMode. Use "original", "enhanced", or "normalized".
Document is not ready for export (status: processing). Poll GET /v1/documents/{id} until status is "completed".

404.description: Document or completed processing run not found.

error.message: Document not found.
Failed to generate CSV export: no transactions found.

post.description: Submit a password to unlock and process a password-protected PDF. The document must have status `password_required`. On success, the document transitions to `processing` status. Rate limit: 20 requests per minute.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document UUID returned from the upload endpoint.

password.description: The password to unlock the PDF. Used in memory only for decryption and never stored.

200.description: Password accepted. Document is now processing.

400.description: Invalid request (e.g., document is not in `password_required` status).

error.message: Document status is "processing", not "password_required".
Document not found.
The password provided is incorrect. Please try again.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded or maximum unlock attempts reached.

error.message: Rate limit exceeded. Try again later.
Maximum unlock attempts (10) exceeded. Please re-upload the file to try again.

post.description: Categorize a document's transactions using AI. Returns cached categories if already generated (no credit charge). Otherwise deducts 1 credit and runs LLM-based categorization. Rate limit: 20 requests per minute.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Document UUID returned by the upload endpoint.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 content hash of the original file.

mappings.description: Map of transaction sequence number to category ID.

error.message: Insufficient credits. Categorization requires 1 credit.
Document not found.
Document is not ready for categorization (status: processing). Poll GET /v1/documents/{id} until status is "completed".

get.description: Returns the current credit balance for the authenticated user. Recommended: call this before large uploads to ensure sufficient credits. 1 credit = 1 page. Rate limit: 120 requests per minute.

Cache-Control.description: Caching directive. Response is cached for 5 seconds.

limit.description: Plan allowance. 10 for free, plan-specific for paid. null when the plan has no monthly allowance (e.g. enterprise).

creditsExpireAt.description: When current plan credits reset, or null for plans without expiry.

post.summary: Evaluate parsed transactions against benchmark ground truth
post.description: Submit parsed transactions from a [Bank Statement Parsing Benchmark](https://github.com/bankstatemently/bank-statement-parsing-benchmark) PDF for scoring. The `contentHash` is the SHA-256 hex digest of the PDF you parsed — this ties the evaluation to the exact file. Free to use, no credits consumed. Rate limit: 50 requests per hour.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the benchmark PDF file.

transactions.description: Parsed transactions from the benchmark statement (max 2000).

200.description: Evaluation results with both normalized and parsed scores.

get.summary: Read your own rating for a document
get.description: Returns the caller's own stored rating for this document, or `data: null` if the caller has not rated it yet. Rate limit: 10 requests per minute.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Document UUID returned by the upload endpoint.

200.description: The caller's own rating, or null.

hasFeedback.description: Whether structured or free-text feedback is stored for this rating.

hasUseCase.description: Whether use-case tags are stored for this rating.

data.description: null when the caller has not rated this document.

error.message: Document not found.

put.summary: Submit or update your rating for a document
put.description: Submits (or updates) the caller's own 1-5 rating for a completed document. Changing the rating clears any previously-stored feedback for it (feedback is tied to the rating it was given for). Requires the caller's own document to be in `completed` status. Rate limit: 10 requests per minute.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Document UUID returned by the upload endpoint.

useCase.description: Tags describing what the converted data is used for.

error.message: Invalid parameters: rating: Number must be less than or equal to 5.

409.description: The caller's own document is not found or not yet `completed`.

error.message: Document not found or not yet processed.

patch.summary: Submit structured feedback on your rating
patch.description: Adds structured feedback (categories and/or free text) to the caller's own existing rating. Only accepted when the caller's own rating is 3 or below. Rate limit: 10 requests per minute.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Document UUID returned by the upload endpoint.

schema.description: At least one of `categories` or `feedback` is required.

example.feedback: Missed two rows near the end of the statement.

data.feedback: Missed two rows near the end of the statement.

400.description: At least one of categories or feedback is required.

error.message: Invalid parameters: At least one category or feedback text is required.

404.description: The caller has no rating of their own for this document yet.

error.message: Rating not found.

409.description: Feedback is only accepted for ratings of 3 or below.

error.message: Feedback is only accepted for ratings of 3 or below.

patch.summary: Submit use-case tags for your rating
patch.description: Adds or updates use-case tags on the caller's own existing rating. A silent no-op (still 200) if the caller has not rated this document yet — use-case is only captured once a rating exists. Rate limit: 10 requests per minute.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Document UUID returned by the upload endpoint.

200.description: Use-case tags stored (or silently no-op'd if the caller has not rated this document yet).

error.message: Invalid parameters: useCase: Array must contain at least 1 element(s).

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: API key for authentication. Obtain one from the Bankstatemently dashboard.

X-Request-Id.description: Unique identifier for this request, useful for debugging and support.

X-API-Version.description: The API version used to process this request. Always `1` for v1 endpoints.

X-Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present and set to `true` when the response was served from the idempotency cache rather than reprocessed.

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying a rate-limited request.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed in the current rate limit window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the current rate limit window resets.

DocumentStatus.description: The processing status of a document.

ExportDataMode.description: The data mode to export. `original` returns raw extracted data; `enhanced` (default) includes AI-enriched fields; `normalized` applies standardized formatting.

ApiErrorType.description: Broad error category (5 values, frozen). Determines the developer's retry/handling strategy.

ApiErrorCode.description: Specific error code (append-only, never rename or repurpose). Use this for granular programmatic handling.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error with actionable context. Do not parse this — use `code` for programmatic handling.

meta.description: Optional structured data for programmatic use. Shape varies by `code`. Only present when actionable data exists.

request_id.description: The unique request identifier. Include this when contacting support.

ExportUrls.description: URLs to download the document in each export format.

StatementPeriod.description: The date range covered by a single statement within the document.

from.description: Start date of the statement period (ISO 8601).

to.description: End date of the statement period (ISO 8601).

StatementSummary.description: Summary of a single bank statement found within the uploaded document.

index.description: Zero-based index of this statement within the document.

statementPeriod.description: The date range of the statement, or null if not detected.

transactionCount.description: Number of transactions in this statement, or null if not yet counted.

DocumentMetadata.description: Metadata about the uploaded document, populated once processing completes.

bank.description: Detected bank or financial institution name.

pageCount.description: Number of pages in the uploaded PDF.

transactionCount.description: Total number of transactions extracted from the document.

accountCount.description: Number of bank accounts found in the document.

StatementUploadResponse.description: Response returned when a PDF is successfully accepted for processing.

id.description: Unique document identifier. Use this to poll status and request exports.

contentHash.description: Content-addressable hash of the uploaded file.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the document was created.

statements.description: Always an empty array on upload; populated once processing completes.

self.description: URL to poll for processing status.

unlock.description: URL to submit a password for unlocking. Only present when status is `password_required`.

StatementDetailResponse.description: Full document status including statement metadata and export URLs when completed.

contentHash.description: Content-addressable hash of the uploaded file.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the document was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last status update.

document.description: Document-level metadata. Present only when status is `completed`.

statements.description: Individual bank statements found in the document. Empty until processing completes.

exports.description: Export download URLs. Present only when status is `completed`.

error.description: Human-readable error message. Present only when status is `failed`.

data.description: URL for structured document data. Present only when status is `completed`.

unlock.description: URL to submit a password for unlocking. Present only when status is `password_required`.

StatementListItem.description: A document summary as returned in the list endpoint.

contentHash.description: Content-addressable hash of the uploaded file.

filename.description: Original filename of the uploaded PDF.

pageCount.description: Number of pages in the uploaded PDF.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the document was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last status update.

exports.description: Export download URLs. Present only when status is `completed`.

total.description: Total number of documents matching the query.

limit.description: Maximum number of documents returned in this page.

hasMore.description: Whether there are more results beyond this page.

amount.description: Transaction amount. Positive absolute value, or negative to indicate debit. When direction is also provided, positive amounts are treated as absolute values.

direction.description: Explicit direction. If omitted, inferred from amount sign (negative = debit, positive/zero = credit). Negative amount with direction "credit" is rejected as contradictory.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to statement currency.

originalData.description: Raw column values as they appear in the PDF.

integrity.description: Structural correctness: validation checks, row coverage, polarity accuracy (0-1).

fields.description: Per-field accuracy scores. Normalized uses canonical names (date, description, amount). Parsed uses original column headers from the PDF.

matched.description: Transactions matched between submission and ground truth.

missing.description: Transactions in ground truth but not in submission.

extra.description: Transactions in submission but not in ground truth.

contentHash.description: Echo of the submitted content hash.

challenges.description: Parsing challenges present in the statement.

normalizedScore.description: Scores against canonical values (ISO dates, numeric amounts).

parsedScore.description: Scores against raw PDF cell values.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication failed, API key revoked, or API key expired.

error.message: Invalid API key provided.
This API key has been revoked. Generate a new key at the Developer Portal.
This API key has expired. Generate a new key at the Developer Portal.

invalid_export_token.summary: Export download token is invalid, expired, or doesn't match this document (export endpoint only)

error.message: This download link has expired or is invalid. Ask your AI assistant for a fresh link, or sign in with an API key.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Wait the number of seconds indicated by the `Retry-After` header.

error.message: Rate limit exceeded. Retry after 12 seconds.
An unexpected error occurred. If this persists, contact support with the request_id.
Document processing is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

NotFound.description: The requested endpoint does not exist.

error.message: The requested endpoint does not exist.
